children: SD Guthrie joint venture's 1.0 billion ringgit land sale likely signals strong demand for industrial land in the Malaysian state of Negeri Sembilan, says Public Investment Bank analyst Chong Hoe Leong in a note. Eco Business Park 7, in which SD Guthrie owns 30%, is selling 222 acres in Port Dickson to Singapore-based Tera Data Centers. The deal is expected to generate about 245 million ringgit in gains for SD Guthrie, he says. The sale could support further land sales in the area, with growing demand for data centers providing an additional growth driver, he adds. Public IB maintains an outperform rating on SD Guthrie and keeps target price at 7.81 ringgit. Shares are 0.3% higher at 6.30 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
